full_judgment:
Syed J.R. Mudassir Hussain, J.: This Revision Application under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure has been filed by Fazlur Rahman challenging an order dated 12-2-96 passed by the learned Senior Assistant Judge, Gobindagonj, District Gaibandha in Other Suit No. 34 of 1992 rejecting the prayer for staying the proceedings of the said suit till disposal of Other Suit No. 95 of 1993 filed by the petitioner for setting aside the ex parte preliminary decree of other suit being Partition Suit No. 212 of 1959. 

 2. The petitioner's case is that Tofa Bibi and Misiron filed the aforesaid Partition Suit No. 212 of 1959 and they obtained an ex parte preliminary decree on 12-8-63 for 2.47 acres of land in excess of their share without the knowledge of the petitioner's mother who was a co-sharer of the ejamali property. The said Tofa Bibi and Misiron sold 1.29 acres out of the said decretal land measuring 2.47 to one Humayun Kabir who having failed to get saham in his purchased land of 1.29, filed a suit being Other Suit No. 34 of 1992 for partition of his alleged purchased share of 1.29 acres in the said court below. The petitioner's further case was that he came to know about the fraudulent ex parte decree of the original partition Suit No. 212 of 1959 from the plaint of Other Suit No. 34 of 1992 filed by Humayun Kabir and the petitioner was then obliged to file a suit being Other Suit No. 95 of 1993 for setting aside the said ex parte decree of the original partition suit dated 12-8-63. Both the Other Suit No.34 of 1992 and the other suit No. 95 of 1993 are now pending in the same court of Senior Assistant Judge Gobindagonj and in such view of the matter the petitioner prayed before the court below for stay of the proceeding of Other Suit No. 34 of 1992 till the disposal of his other suit No. 95 of 1993 in order to avoid conflicting decision, multiplicity of suit and harassment if the previously instituted suit, being Other Suit No. 34 of 1992, is decided before the hearing of the petitioner's subsequent Other Suit No. 95 of 1993 but the petitioner's said prayer was rejected by his order dated 12-6-96 which has been impugned in this application.
